Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly interpret the visual layout of the webpage. The task required finding the rhyme on a headstone *visible in the background* of the photo for the oldest flavor (Dastardly Mash). While the agent correctly identified Dastardly Mash as the oldest flavor, it incorrectly concluded that the background headstone was "Cr me Brulee" and extracted the rhyme from that flavor's main entry instead of the specific background image associated with Dastardly Mash. The agent hallucinated the content of the background image based on the list of flavors present on the page rather than analyzing the specific image provided for Dastardly Mash, leading to the extraction of the wrong rhyme ("So it may not be beaucoup too late to save Cr me Brulee from beyond the grave") instead of the correct one ("So we had to let it die").
